home.seo_p1: At OWNEO we revolutionise the concept of luxury supercar sharing in Spain, making the dream of driving the world's most exclusive vehicles a reality.
home.seo_p1_body: Our exclusive fleet includes the most coveted Ferrari supercars, the power of a Lamborghini or the full Porsche range: the 911 Turbo S, the electric Taycan and the Cayenne and Macan sport SUVs.
home.seo_p2_body: Discover the refinement of the Aston Martin DB11, the aerodynamic innovation of the McLaren 720S, or the supreme luxury of the Rolls-Royce Wraith. Complete your experience with the craftsmanship of the Bentley Continental GT or the power of the Mercedes-AMG GT R, known as 'The Beast of the Green Hell'.
home.seo_footer: From sharing a Ferrari in Barcelona to a Lamborghini in Marbella, OWNEO gives you the opportunity to live unique experiences behind the wheel of the world's finest supercars. Discover why we are leaders in luxury car sharing and supercar experiences in Spain.
home.intro_para: A brand that redefines access to high-end cars through shared ownership: an efficient, modern and aspirational model, aligned with the new way of understanding mobility.

With OWNEO, access a premium supercar fleet in Spain's finest locations: Barcelona, Madrid, Marbella, Valencia, Ibiza and Alicante.

model.title: The smartest way into
model.subtitle: OWNEO reinvents your relationship with high-end cars. You don't buy a car. You don't rent one. You acquire the right to enjoy it as if it were yours — with the full service, without any of the burdens.
model.body_intro: OWNEO reinvents your relationship with high-end cars. You don't buy a car. You don't rent one. You acquire the right to enjoy it as if it were yours — with the full service, without any of the burdens.
model.eyebrow: Right of use · All inclusive · No obligations
model.hero_title: The smartest way into luxury motoring
model.hero_subtitle: OWNEO reinvents your relationship with high-end cars. You don't buy a car. You don't rent one. You acquire the right to enjoy it as if it were yours — with the full service, without any of the burdens.
model.includes_subtitle: An OWNEO participation is a right-of-use contract on a specific vehicle. You choose the car, acquire your participation, and OWNEO takes care of absolutely everything else.
model.card1_note: Want more time? Acquire more participations in the same vehicle or in other models from the fleet.
model.card2_note: Guaranteed kilometres per participation and per year, with the vehicle always immaculate and ready.
model.card3_title: Clear and unique entry price. No hidden fees, no surprises. OWNEO manages the rest.
model.card4_note: One annual fee covers insurance, maintenance, parking and all management. You manage absolutely nothing.
model.we_handle_title: You drive. We handle everything else.
model.we_handle_subtitle: From the purchase of the vehicle to its resale, through every service, every insurance and every delivery — OWNEO manages every detail so you only have to enjoy.
model.step1_desc: OWNEO acquires the vehicle from certified official dealers. You don't worry about negotiation or paperwork.
model.step2_desc: Clear contract guaranteeing your 4 weeks (3 standard + 1 premium) per year per participation and all rights of use.
model.step3_desc: Full coverage with a premium insurer. Each participant is covered as a regular driver.
model.step4_desc: All scheduled services and repairs managed by OWNEO. The vehicle always in perfect condition.
model.step5_desc: An OWNEO manager delivers the vehicle to you in person, immaculately prepared, checked and documented.
model.step6_desc: At the end of the agreed period (indicated on each vehicle's page), OWNEO manages the sale and redistributes the value among participants.
model.delivery_title: Every time you pick up your car, it's immaculate.
model.delivery_desc: Before each delivery, our team prepares the vehicle professionally: full valet, technical inspection, photographic record of its condition. An OWNEO manager hands it over in person. You just have to sit behind the wheel.
model.trust_title: Your participation is backed by a contract, insurance and a rigorous verification protocol.
model.trust_subtitle: Hover over each card to learn more.
model.trust1_desc: Full technical inspection before each use
model.trust1_back: Each vehicle undergoes a mechanical and aesthetic review before each delivery. We document its condition with photos so you always receive an immaculate car.
model.trust2_back: We validate the identity and profile of each participant. You share your vehicle only with members equally committed.
model.trust3_desc: Your rights of use in writing
model.trust3_back: Your weeks, your kilometres and your conditions are fixed by contract. No ambiguities, no hidden clauses.
model.trust4_desc: Full coverage with a recognised insurer
model.trust4_back: Comprehensive policy with a top-tier insurer. Each participant drives covered as a regular driver.
model.trust5_back: One annual fee covers everything: insurance, maintenance, parking and management. You always know exactly what you pay.
model.trust6_back: At the end of the period, we sell the vehicle and return your share. You recover up to 70% thanks to controlled mileage.
model.stats1_desc: Compared to traditional ownership, your annual fee divides all management costs among participants.
model.stats2_desc: When reselling the vehicle at the end of the agreed period, you recover up to 70% of your initial participation thanks to controlled mileage.
model.stats3_desc: OWNEO manages purchase, insurance, maintenance, parking, delivery and resale. Your only responsibility is to enjoy.
model.cta_subtitle: Explore our fleet, choose your vehicle and request your participation. OWNEO handles the rest.
model.cta_tagline: No commitment · 100% digital process · Response within 24h
model.delivery_check2: Professional cleaning and preparation before each use
model.delivery_check3: Personal hand-over and collection by OWNEO manager
model.comparison_body: Transparent analysis of annual management costs (excluding acquisition price and depreciation) compared to traditional ownership.
model.comparison_note: Estimate based on a €250,000 vehicle with controlled mileage. Actual values vary by model. Depreciation and acquisition costs not included in this annual calculation.
model.practical_recovery_note: at end of period · controlled mileage
model.practical_summary: With 1 participation, you enjoy 4 weeks (3 standard + 1 premium) per year in a Porsche 911 Turbo S for €25,000 — and OWNEO manages absolutely everything else.
model.practical_more: Want more time behind the wheel? Acquire 2 participations and enjoy 8 weeks (6 standard + 2 premium) per year — or participate in multiple vehicles from the OWNEO fleet.
model.app_title: Everything in the palm of your hand.
model.app_body: Once you're a participant, you access the OWNEO app — available as a web application from any device. No additional downloads, always available.
model.app_feat1: Book your weeks directly from the app
model.app_feat2: Check your vehicle's status in real time
model.app_feat4: Contact your OWNEO manager at any time
model.app_feat5: View your usage history and available weeks

about.title: It's not a car.
about.subtitle: OWNEO was born to break the equation that for decades has kept automotive luxury reserved for a very few.
about.manifesto_title: Luxury shouldn't be a matter of fortune.
about.manifesto_p1: We believe the world's most extraordinary cars shouldn't be reserved for the few. Not for lack of passion, but because of an economic equation that for decades has made automotive luxury unreachable.
about.manifesto_p2: OWNEO was born to break that equation. Not by democratising luxury downwards — but by elevating access upwards. The same car, the same experience, the same emotion. Without the burden of ownership.
about.mission_desc: We want anyone with the right determination and discernment to be able to sit behind the wheel of a Ferrari, a Porsche or a Bentley — without buying it, without managing anything, without surprises.
about.vision_desc: We aspire to build the most exclusive community of motoring enthusiasts in Europe — where access to the world's finest vehicles is an intelligent decision, not an inherited privilege.
about.profile1_hook: Dreamed of a Ferrari since he was 16. OWNEO makes it possible.
about.profile1_text: No need to wait until you have €300,000 in the bank. With an OWNEO participation, that dream has a date, a plate and 4 guaranteed weeks a year.
about.profile2_hook: Doesn't buy impulses. Buys experiences with real value.
about.profile2_text: An OWNEO participation isn't an expense — it's a financial decision with an estimated return, controlled mileage and managed resale. Luxury that also makes sense on a spreadsheet.
about.profile3_title: The one who lives in the present
about.profile3_hook: Prefers 4 weeks behind the wheel of a Porsche over 365 days worrying about it.
about.profile3_text: No garage, no insurance, no services, no paperwork. Just book via the app, pick up an immaculate car and enjoy. The rest is OWNEO's problem.
about.value1_text: Luxury shouldn't be a privilege of the few. What once required a fortune, today requires an intelligent decision.
about.value2_text: Every contract, every delivery, every euro invested is backed by a real commitment. No hidden clauses.
about.value3_text: We don't manage cars. We manage experiences. And in every detail, we demand the best.
about.value4_text: OWNEO members share more than a car. They share a vision of what luxury should mean.
about.cta_title: Ready to make the intelligent decision?
about.cta_subtitle: Discover exactly how the OWNEO model works, or explore the available vehicles directly and find your participation.
about.cta_tagline: No commitment · 100% digital process · Response within 24h
